entries.title: A crewmate's failed fix now counts as failed when checks share a name
entries.body: When a version of a pull request ran the same check more than once on GitHub, such as the pull request's own run beside runs a crewmate asked for, the app could read a passing run first and count a failed fix as a success. A crewmate could then show two of its three tries used when it had used all three. The app now counts a fix as passed only when every run of that check passed.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen; a crewmate's count of its three tries is now right.
